T1_yellow_is_it_a_box.verdict: open ~3px-wide strokes; device measurement calipers, NOT the paper's LabelImg annotations
T1_yellow_is_it_a_box.consequence_if_not_boxes: the dataset ships NO annotation file -- only a burnt-in device overlay. It therefore cannot supply the nail boundary, i.e. cannot supply the DENOMINATOR for Ìõ/mm or for the per-nailfold fields.

clusters_link_30px.caveat: cluster count depends on the arbitrary 30 px link

T2_scale_and_instance_count.verdict: one red dot is NOT one capillary: the dots sit ~6.7x closer than our vessels do, and 66.9% of them lie in multi-dot clusters. They trace the CONTOUR of a loop. The usable instance count is the cluster count (~4252), not the dot count.

nfc_vs_nfb.argument: NFB in SSc are single-digit per nail and absent in many nails, so an NFB channel must be strongly zero-inflated. This channel is not.
nfc_vs_nfb.verdict: red marks CAPILLARIES (NFC); the hemorrhage branch is ruled out
